# T-5: Aggregate review metrics

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Compute guardrail trend, review finding trend, repair effectiveness, and search result datasets from loaded artifacts.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Guardrail counts and phase distribution are computed from issue-log data
- Finding counts are grouped by phase, category, and spec
- Disappearance and same-category reappearance rates use adjacent recorded attempts only
- Attempt-limit spec list is populated from issue-log evidence and flow.json retry metrics
- Search filters by keyword and exact category match

## Implementation Notes
Do not infer metrics from overwritten latest artifacts. Use explicit unknown states when adjacent attempts are missing.

## Test Strategy
Aggregation tests for multi-spec fixtures, adjacent attempt comparisons, category reappearance, keyword search, and missing-history unknowns.
